summary: mount_facts returns ansible_facts with mount_points keyed by mount point (with source context) and optionally aggregate_mounts.
questions: How do I find which file defined a mount?

answer_card.title: mount_facts return values
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible_facts.mount_points`: dict keyed by mount point (like `ansible_facts.mounts` entries) plus `ansible_context` with source file/lines. `aggregate_mounts` list when enabled.
